sections.h2: Doctors: India's registry reaches at most 67%, Estonia's EHR 95%+

sections.means: Registration is voluntary in India but tied to practice in Estonia, which explains part of the gap.
sections.todo: Publish a doctors-only HPR count so the 67% upper bound can be replaced by a true share.

sections.todo: Make NHCX integration mandatory for insurers, as the IRDAI panel recommends.
